ground_truth_protocol.description: HART-IP (TCP/UDP 5094). The 8-byte header is followed by the message body; pass-through messages carry a HART PDU whose command selects the type. Derived from the Wireshark/tshark dissection of the benchmark capture (dol/truth-file-derivation/scripts/build_truth.py): fields at a fixed offset in at least 60% of a type's messages, bitfields sharing a byte merged, arrays of 3+ equal fields and variable-position content kept as one bytes field (the modbus.json convention for register arrays); types with fewer than 5 messages are omitted.
ground_truth_protocol.offset_convention: Header fields use wire-absolute offsets 0..7; body types are relative to the body (offset 0 = wire offset 8).
